insights.concise_text: Because projection based transfer schemes require parallel corpora and Armenian lacked a sufficiently large parallel corpus with a resource-rich language, the authors chose the Wikipedia-link model for automated data generation.

triple.object: choice of the Wikipedia-link model for Armenian automated data generation
